summary: Minimal, correct fix that adds a secondary grouping key so 'import X' statements sort before 'from X import Y' statements, matching Django coding style and isort defaults. Includes an explanatory comment; fully resolves the issue without regression.

issues.description: Sort within each group is plain string compare on module path, not isort's case-insensitive/section-aware ordering. Adequate for generated migrations (small, predictable import set) and matches the issue's example, so not blocking.
